title: Looks great, very padded... However.. Non skid my foot!
text: Looks great, very padded... However.. Non skid my foot!. I was excited to see that the set looks better in person than on line.. and though a bit narrow for someone of my sixe they are plenyt padded.. BUT.. Non skid.. IS NON EXISTANT.. Clean 12x12 tile ceramic tile.. and skid like I am playing air hockey.. SO If you want pad and looks this is it.. but if you need non skid look elsewhere.. I am making this comment while on here looking for something to put under them or replace them.. under probably
